create_asynchronous_questionnaire: create an AsynchronousQuestionnaire component with questionnaires and player names for async agent interactions
reset_questionnaire: reset the AsynchronousQuestionnaire component to its initial state clearing all answers and indices
check_is_done: check if the questionnaire is finished for a specific player or all players
get_answers: get a deep copy of all player answers collected by the AsynchronousQuestionnaire component
get_questionnaires_results: aggregate questionnaire results into a pandas DataFrame with flattened choice similarity scores
